verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs show rules with targeting conditions on SDK attributes such as user ID, plus saved groups. They also show layering a forced value for beta testers above a gradual rollout, so targeting specific individuals is documented. Explicit exclusion of individual users, allowlist management for internal accounts, and the mechanics of building ID lists are not shown. missing for 10: documented exclusion/deny-list of specific users, detail on saved-group ID allowlists for internal accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration of per-user targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)
